hybrid_claim.operational_definition: A panel qualifies when it contains a decorated angular multi-arm figure and a plain crossed-loop figure whose lobes are one broad triangle and one small quadrilateral, and rotation aligns the figures so their distinctive large, small, and inner landmarks occur in the same clockwise order.
hybrid_claim.phrase: Complete paired motifs with shared rotational handedness

required_visual_cues.positive_description: The plain-line figure has a broad triangular lobe and a smaller quadrilateral lobe joined at a crossing.
The decorated figure has an angular outer spine plus inward-projecting arms traced with contrasting square, circular, triangular, and dark serrated marks.
Using each figure’s principal junction and small appendage as orientation landmarks, the broad lobe or outer spine and the inner appendage follow the same clockwise order in both figures.
